1.w: And Job took up his discourse again:

2.w: “As surely as God lives, who has denied me justice, the Almighty, who has made my life bitter —

3.w: for while my spirit is still in me, and the breath from God is in my nostrils,

4.w: my lips will not speak wickedness, and my tongue will whisper no deceit.

5.w: I will never declare that you three are in the right; until I die, I will not set aside my integrity!

6.w: I will maintain my righteousness and never let it go; my conscience will not reproach me for as long as I live.

7.w: “May my enemy be like the wicked, my adversary like the unrighteous.

8.w: For what hope does the godless have when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

9.w: Does God listen to his cry when distress overtakes him?

10.w: Will he find delight in the Almighty? Will he call out to God at all times?

11.w: I will teach you about the power of God; what is on the Almighty’s mind I will not conceal.

12.w: If you yourselves have all seen this, Why in the world do you continue this meaningless talk?

13.w: This is the portion of the wicked man allotted by God, the inheritance that evildoers receive from the Almighty.

14.w: If his children increase—it is for the sword! His offspring never have enough to eat.

15.w: Those who survive him are buried by the plague, and their widows do not mourn for them.

16.w: If he piles up silver like dust and stores up clothing like mounds of clay,

17.w: what he stores up a righteous man will wear, and an innocent man will inherit his silver.

18.w: The house he builds is as fragile as a moth’s cocoon, like a hut that a watchman has made.

19.w: He goes to bed wealthy, but will do so no more. When he opens his eyes, it is all gone.

20.w: Terrors overwhelm him like a flood; at night a whirlwind carries him off.

21.w: The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.

22.w: It hurls itself against him without pity as he flees headlong from its power.

23.w: It claps its hands at him in derision and hisses him away from his place.
